_doc: NO-NEW-AXIOMS RATCHET for the clean-verify self-verification spec.
CENSUS BY KERNEL GROUND TRUTH: this file PINS the full set of constants the kernel
ENVIRONMENT holds as ConstantKind::Axiom (value-less declarations the kernel takes on
faith), enumerated by walking Specification::env() in clean_verify::axiom_ratchet::
live_env_axioms — NOT the SpecDefinition is_axiom FLAG. The flag and the lowered kernel
form CAN DIVERGE: prepare_definition_decl (spec/definition_registration.rs) chooses
Declaration::Axiom SOLELY when the value is absent, NEVER consulting is_axiom. So a
SpecDefinition with {is_axiom:false, value_src:None} lowers to a GENUINE kernel axiom that
the old flag-based census never saw (the C1 hole). Keying on kernel ConstantKind::Axiom
(value-absence) closes that hole AND the M1 env-vs-defs blind spot (axioms injected via
env_mut().add_decl with no SpecDefinition at all, e.g. the kernel's propext / Quot.sound /
Classical.choice bedrock, the Quot quotient primitives, and trust markers).
An AXIOM is an ASSUMPTION the kernel does NOT check for truth (exactly the kind of thing
that let two FALSE micro_whnf axioms hide for a long time, retired in 11e047bd).
ENFORCEMENT: tests/axiom_ratchet.rs::no_new_admitted_axioms_in_spec, via
clean_verify::axiom_ratchet::newly_admitted_axioms. SUBSET semantics: a LIVE kernel-env
axiom name absent from this golden FAILS the test (a new silent admission); proving an
axiom away (value-less → value-bearing, so the kernel stops treating it as an axiom)
SHRINKS the live set, stays a subset, still PASSES — the ongoing drain is never blocked.
TO LEGITIMATELY UPDATE: (1) PREFERRED — PROVE the axiom away (give the SpecDefinition a
real value so it lowers to Theorem/Opaque, not Axiom); the live set shrinks and the test
still passes, no edit needed here. (2) If a NEW axiom is genuinely intended, ADD its name
below (and bump `count`) WITH a justification in review — an explicit, reviewable diff.
`origin` is informational: FlagAxiom = SpecDefinition is_axiom:true that lowered to an
axiom; PendingLeaf = is_axiom:false yet STILL a kernel axiom (the flag/value divergence —
value-less DerivedLemma forward decls with no proof term yet); EnvInjected = a kernel axiom
with no backing SpecDefinition. The test keys ONLY on `name`.
